How does this ruling square with:

The Sleeping Mind [Sabbat:C, SW:C, Third:PTr]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Dominate
Only usable when the action is announced.
[dom] Choose a tapped vampire. He or she cannot attempt to block this
action.
[DOM] Minions cannot untap during this action.

The text of
Madness Network [Jyhad:R, VTES:R, CE:R]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Malkavian
Unique master.
Put this card in play. After [a Methuselah] has finished all of his or
her minion phase actions, any untapped Malkavians [controlled by other
Methuselahs] (going clockwise) can take actions. Any minion can burn
this card as an action that any untapped Malkavian (in addition to the
normally eligible blockers) can attempt to block (go clockwise if 2 or
more want to block).

directly states untapped. waked minions are by default still tapped,
and cannot block. This ruling allowing tapped vampires to block the
madness network, changes the way the Sleeping Mind works since it also
states that a tapped minion cannot block.

A little explanation could be used here.

Thanks

Raille

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:
On Jan 7, 12:09 pm, Raille <rai...@yahoo.com> wrote:
> http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_t...


The Sleeping Mind sets up an ongoing effect that makes a particular
minion (the chosen, currently tapped minion) unable to block, even if
that minion later untaps.

Madness Network does not set up an ongoing effect that bars minions
from blocking, so 'attempting to block as though untapped' is
sufficient to get around the 'any untapped Malkavian can attempt to
block' restriction.

witness1
